messages:
Maya: Hey team — thinking of doing a hybrid LAN night Sat Mar 27, 7pm in the HQ lounge. Projector + couch available. Anyone up for couch (local) vs cloud (remote via Parsec) casuals?
Jordan: Im in. Can bring a cheap capture dongle if ppl want clips.
Sam: Ill bring my Steam Deck + snacks (no peanuts pls 36a). Need at least one power strip.
Alex: I can bring 2 power strips, a 5-port ethernet switch, and a spare AP if wifi gets flaky. Wired host = 👍
Maya: Nice — planning a rotating "couch vs cloud" bracket. Short rounds, swap players, low stress.
Jordan: Games: Mario Kart, TowerFall, Overcooked? Also maybe a co-op indie.
Noah: I have a Switch + dock and a big battery bank for Decks. Also a karaoke mic for when we get too confident 602
Sam: I can run Parsec hosts. Quick command I use: 
```
parsec host --name redwood-lan --quality 60
```
Jordan: Pro tip: run host machine on wired ethernet for stability.
Alex: Agreed. Also please label controllers/cables with painter's tape so we don't lose them.
Maya: Allergy note: someone in the lounge is allergic to peanuts — please avoid peanut-heavy stuff.
Sam: Bringing extra microSD cards and a small USB-C hub for extra Decks.
Jordan: React to RSVP with: :joystick: console, :computer: PC/Deck, :handshake: bringing power strip/switch, :taco: bringing snacks.
Alex: :handshake:
Noah: :computer: :taco:
Maya: Ill set a reminder — @DevRel Bot can ping #random two days before?
DevRel Bot: Reminder set: "LAN night — Mar 27, 7pm — bring controllers, cables, and snacks (no peanuts)". Posting in #random on Mar 25 at 10:00.
Jordan: If anyone wants to stream a match, bring capture gear or we can record clips from the Decks.
Sam: If you need an FFmpeg snippet for local recording, DM me.
Alex: I dug up a wireless GameCube adapter from the drawer — bringing it just in case.
Maya: Sweet. Ill post a short RSVP thread later and drop a couch layout map so people can claim spots. See yall Sat! :party_parrot:
